lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਜੀਵੈ ਦਾਸੁ ਤੁਮੑ ਬਾਣੀ ਜਨ ਆਖੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: sun sun jeevai daas tumh baanee jan aakhee ||
lines.translation: Your slave lives by hearing, hearing the Word of Your Bani, chanted by Your humble servant.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਭਈ ਸਭ ਲੋਅ ਮਹਿ ਸੇਵਕ ਕੀ ਰਾਖੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: pragat bhaee sabh lo mahi sevak kee raakhee ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: The Guru is revealed in all the worlds; He saves the honor of His servant. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਗਨਿ ਸਾਗਰ ਤੇ ਕਾਢਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਜਲਨਿ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: agan saagar te kaadhiaa prabh jalan bujhaaee ||
lines.translation: God has pulled me out of the ocean of fire, and quenched my burning thirst.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਲੁ ਸੰਚਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਭਏ ਸਹਾਈ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)mrit naam jal sa(n)chiaa gur bhae sahaaee ||2||
lines.translation: The Guru has sprinkled the Ambrosial Water of the Naam, the Name of the Lord; He has become my Helper. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਦੁਖ ਕਾਟਿਆ ਸੁਖ ਕਾ ਥਾਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: janam maran dukh kaatiaa sukh kaa thaan paaiaa ||
lines.translation: The pains of birth and death are removed, and I have obtained a resting place of peace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਟੀ ਸਿਲਕ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਮੋਹ ਕੀ ਅਪਨੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: kaatee silak bhram moh kee apane prabh bhaaiaa ||3||
lines.translation: The noose of doubt and emotional attachment has been snapped; I have become pleasing to my God. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਤ ਕੋਈ ਜਾਣਹੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਕਛੁ ਸਭ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਹਾਥਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: mat koee jaanahu avar kachh sabh prabh kai haath ||
lines.translation: Let no one think that there is any other at all; everything is in the Hands of God.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਸੂਖ ਨਾਨਕ ਪਾਏ ਸੰਗਿ ਸੰਤਨ ਸਾਥਿ ॥੪॥੨੨॥੫੨॥
lines.transliteration: sarab sookh naanak paae sa(n)g sa(n)tan saath ||4||22||52||
lines.translation: Nanak has found total peace, in the Society of the Saints. ||4||22||52||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਬੰਧਨ ਕਾਟੇ ਆਪਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਹੋਆ ਕਿਰਪਾਲ ॥
lines.transliteration: ba(n)dhan kaate aap prabh hoaa kirapaal ||
lines.translation: My bonds have been snapped; God Himself has become compassionate.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: deen daiaal prabh paarabraham taa kee nadar nihaal ||1||
lines.translation: The Supreme Lord God is Merciful to the meek; by His Glance of Grace, I am in ecstasy. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੀ ਕਾਟਿਆ ਦੁਖੁ ਰੋਗੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur poorai kirapaa karee kaatiaa dukh rog ||
lines.translation: The Perfect Guru has shown mercy to me, and eradicated my pains and illnesses.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਸੁਖੀ ਭਇਆ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਧਿਆਵਨ ਜੋਗੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: man tan seetal sukhee bhaiaa prabh dhiaavan jog ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: My mind and body have been cooled and soothed, meditating on God, most worthy of meditation. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਉਖਧੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਤੁ ਰੋਗੁ ਨ ਵਿਆਪੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: aukhadh har kaa naam hai jit rog na viaapai ||
lines.translation: The Name of the Lord is the medicine to cure all disease; with it, no disease afflicts me.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਹਿਤੈ ਫਿਰਿ ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਜਾਪੈ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: saadhasa(n)g man tan hitai phir dookh na jaapai ||2||
lines.translation: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, the mind and body are tinged with the Lord's Love, and I do not suffer pain any longer. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਪੀਐ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: har har har har jaapeeai a(n)tar liv laaee ||
lines.translation: I chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, Har, Har, lovingly centering my inner being on Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਉਤਰਹਿ ਸੁਧੁ ਹੋਇ ਸਾਧੂ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: kilavikh utarahi sudh hoi saadhoo saranaaee ||3||
lines.translation: Sinful mistakes are erased and I am sanctified, in the Sanctuary of the Holy Saints. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਨਤ ਜਪਤ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਜਸੁ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਦੂਰਿ ਬਲਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: sunat japat har naam jas taa kee door balaaee ||
lines.translation: Misfortune is kept far away from those who hear and chant the Praises of the Lord's Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਹਾ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਕਥੈ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਈ ॥੪॥੨੩॥੫੩॥
lines.transliteration: mahaa ma(n)tr naanak kathai har ke gun gaaee ||4||23||53||
lines.translation: Nanak chants the Mahaa Mantra, the Great Mantra, singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||4||23||53||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਭੈ ਤੇ ਉਪਜੈ ਭਗਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਹੋਇ ਸਾਂਤਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhai te upajai bhagat prabh a(n)tar hoi saa(n)t ||
lines.translation: From the Fear of God, devotion wells up, and deep within, there is peace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਕਾ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਭ੍ਰਾਂਤਿ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naam japat govi(n)d kaa binasai bhram bhraa(n)t ||1||
lines.translation: Chanting the Name of the Lord of the Universe, doubt and delusions are dispelled. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਭੇਟਿਆ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਸੁਖਿ ਪਰਵੇਸੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur pooraa jis bhetiaa taa kai sukh paraves ||
lines.translation: One who meets with the Perfect Guru, is blessed with peace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਕੀ ਮਤਿ ਤਿਆਗੀਐ ਸੁਣੀਐ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: man kee mat tiaageeai suneeai upades ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: So renounce the intellectual cleverness of your mind, and listen to the Teachings. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਤ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਸਿਮਰੀਐ ਸੋ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: simarat simarat simareeai so purakh daataar ||
lines.translation: Meditate, meditate, meditate in remembrance on the Primal Lord, the Great Giver.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਤੇ ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਸੋ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: man te kabahu na veesarai so purakh apaar ||2||
lines.translation: May I never forget that Primal, Infinite Lord from my mind. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਸਿਉ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਗਾ ਅਚਰਜ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ॥
lines.transliteration: charan kamal siu ra(n)g lagaa acharaj guradev ||
lines.translation: I have enshrined love for the Lotus Feet of the Wondrous Divine Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਲਾਵਹੁ ਸੇਵ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: jaa kau kirapaa karahu prabh taa kau laavahu sev ||3||
lines.translation: One who is blessed by Your Mercy, God, is committed to Your service. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿਧਿ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਆ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਆਨੰਦ ॥
lines.transliteration: nidh nidhaan a(n)mrit peeaa man tan aana(n)d ||
lines.translation: I drink in the Ambrosial Nectar, the treasure of wealth, and my mind and body are in bliss.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਰਮਾਨੰਦ ॥੪॥੨੪॥੫੪॥
lines.transliteration: naanak kabahu na veesarai prabh paramaana(n)d ||4||24||54||
lines.translation: Nanak never forgets God, the Lord of supreme bliss. ||4||24||54||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨ ਬੁਝੀ ਮਮਤਾ ਗਈ ਨਾਠੇ ਭੈ ਭਰਮਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: trisan bujhee mamataa gaee naathe bhai bharamaa ||
lines.translation: Desire is stilled, and egotism is gone; fear and doubt have run away.

lines.gurmukhi: ਥਿਤਿ ਪਾਈ ਆਨਦੁ ਭਇਆ ਗੁਰਿ ਕੀਨੇ ਧਰਮਾ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: thit paaee aanad bhaiaa gur keene dharamaa ||1||
lines.translation: I have found stability, and I am in ecstasy; the Guru has blessed me with Dharmic faith. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਆਰਾਧਿਆ ਬਿਨਸੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਪੀਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur pooraa aaraadhiaa binasee meree peer ||
lines.translation: Worshipping the Perfect Guru in adoration, my anguish is eradicated.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਸਭੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਭਇਆ ਪਾਇਆ ਸੁਖੁ ਬੀਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: tan man sabh seetal bhaiaa paaiaa sukh beer ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: My body and mind are totally cooled and soothed; I have found peace, O my brother. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋਵਤ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਜਾਗਿਆ ਪੇਖਿਆ ਬਿਸਮਾਦੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: sovat har jap jaagiaa pekhiaa bisamaad ||
lines.translation: I have awakened from sleep, chanting the Name of the Lord; gazing upon Him, I am filled with wonder.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੀ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਸਿਆ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਅਚਰਜ ਸੁਆਦੁ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: pee a(n)mrit tripataasiaa taa kaa acharaj suaad ||2||
lines.translation: Drinking in the Ambrosial Nectar, I am satisfied. How wondrous is its taste! ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਸੰਗੀ ਤਰੇ ਕੁਲ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਉਧਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: aap mukat sa(n)gee tare kul kuta(n)b udhaare ||
lines.translation: I myself am liberated, and my companions swim across; my family and ancestors are also saved.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਫਲ ਸੇਵਾ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਕੀ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਦਰਬਾਰੇ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: saphal sevaa guradev kee niramal darabaare ||3||
lines.translation: Service to the Divine Guru is fruitful; it has made me pure in the Court of the Lord. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨੀਚੁ ਅਨਾਥੁ ਅਜਾਨੁ ਮੈ ਨਿਰਗੁਨੁ ਗੁਣਹੀਨੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: neech anaath ajaan mai niragun gunaheen ||
lines.translation: I am lowly, without a master, ignorant, worthless and without virtue.
